configurations.name: backend
runtimeArgs: Get-Content .env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' } | ForEach-Object { $k, $v = $_ -split '=', 2; Set-Item -Path "Env:$k" -Value $v }; & './backend/gradlew.bat' -p backend bootRun

configurations.name: backend-8081
runtimeArgs: Get-Content .env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' } | ForEach-Object { $k, $v = $_ -split '=', 2; Set-Item -Path "Env:$k" -Value $v }; $env:PORT = '8081'; & './backend/gradlew.bat' -p backend bootRun
